_README: Machine-readable companion to DEV_HANDOFF_HI02H11_L02_S01.md. The prose file is authoritative
for rationale; this file is authoritative for DATA — screen order, content, mappings, and the
proposed card schemas. The SME's recommendations are preserved verbatim in
_SME_RECOMMENDATIONS.md; nothing here paraphrases them as if they were instructions.
status values: 'ready' = ships on today's engine · 'reskin' = existing module + TRAIN_CHROME
'new' = new engine module · 'blocked' = needs an SME ruling first

title_hi_conflict.resolution: SME ruling needed — handoff §7 item 1 recommends the note's wording

matra_naming._issue: The notes use both «बड़ी आ की मात्रा» and «आ की मात्रा». Hindi pairs छोटी इ with बड़ी ई; आ has no छोटी/बड़ी counterpart, so «बड़ी आ» is non-standard. The built lesson currently says «बड़ी आ» — an error either way.

screens._vo_correction: SME wrote «शाबाश! परी बन गया।» — परी is feminine, so «बन गई» is correct. Flagged, not silently changed; SME ruling.
screens.sme_correction_applied: SME: «Important correction: Please use हिरण instead of हीरा / hira.» The mockup still shows ह_रा with a diamond. हीरा is unusable regardless — ही + रा is two in-scope matras. obj_hiran art already exists in this bundle.
screens.critical_implementation_note: blank_after_consonant_index is an index into the CONSONANT SEQUENCE, not a character offset. ि is a reordering matra: in हिरण it is stored after ह but DRAWN before it. Render the dashed blank in the DRAWN position and resolve the string by consonant index. A naive character-offset insert puts the matra in the wrong visual place.

poem_audit._method: Every word in the SME's poem checked programmatically for the three in-scope matras.
poem_audit.poem: रवि लाया लाल पतंग, दिन में चमकी सूरज की किरण। नीम तले मीना गाए संग。
poem_audit.why_it_blocks: A child hunting ी who taps चमकी is RIGHT, and the screen as specified would shake it and play «फिर से देखो।» — teaching the opposite of the lesson. Same for गाए in round 1.
poem_audit.multi_round_word: मीना carries both ी and ा, so it is a correct answer in two different rounds. Pedagogically fine, but the module must support a word belonging to more than one round, and 'correct words remain highlighted' must survive a word being found twice.

art_rules: Flat vector, magenta-keyed, autocropped. NEVER pink or near-white without a thick dark outline — a white subject leaves keep_largest nothing to keep and the PNG comes out BLANK (this shipped once as obj_sapna).

Any spiky / rayed / dotted / multi-part subject must be prompted as ONE SINGLE CONNECTED SILHOUETTE — separated parts are disconnected components and keep_largest discards all but one. This cost three attempts on obj_din.
Eyeball art at FULL SIZE, not on a contact sheet. A ray-less sun looked fine at 230px and was obviously wrong at full resolution.

guide actor (ghost, or Swiftie + lens — pending §7 item 6)

tts_constraints._why_here: The dev/VO pipeline must respect these; all four were measured on this bundle, not inferred.

bare_akshara_refused.detail: क, न, द, त all return HTTP 400. Carrier forms are unreliable per letter: «अक्षर त।» synthesises, «अक्षर न।» and «अक्षर द।» refuse after three retries.
bare_akshara_refused.impact: Hits MATRA_BUILD's `onset` clip directly (जा, बि, की). Two-character syllables are safer than bare consonants but must be verified one by one.
bare_akshara_refused.recommendation: Plan on HUMAN RECORDING for the onset clips — they are the pedagogical core of the screen and must not be silent on some letters and spoken on others.

em_dash_truncates.detail: Probed head to head, same words: em-dash 0.73-1.05s, comma 1.53-2.21s, danda 1.13-2.01s. Ten clips in the built lesson shipped half-spoken this way.
em_dash_truncates.impact: Several of the SME's new lines use «यह शब्द है — जल।». Substitute a comma or record by hand.
em_dash_truncates.rule: No em-dash in a short spoken line.

tts_constraints.truncation_is_invisible: A truncated clip exists, is a valid WAV, and is a normal file size. The only detector that works is comparing a clip against others of the same text length — _verify_assets.py §3 does this; keep it in the pipeline.
tts_constraints.din_specific: The word दिन triggers truncation on the Kore voice regardless of retries; two clips in the built lesson are on Aoede for this reason. दिन appears on four of the new screens.
